title: paga_scanpy
description:
PAGA (partition-based graph abstraction) infers the connectivity between cell clusters or
other groupings by quantifying how strongly neighboring partitions of a cell-cell graph are
connected to one another. The result is a coarse-grained, denoised map of the data's
topology that captures both continuous and disconnected structure, and can be used to infer
trajectories between cell populations without assuming an underlying tree-like or linear
shape.

Wolf et al. 2019, Genome Biology

Dataset input.title: Dataset input
Dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple         parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml                 blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

uns_neighbors.description:
The .uns key under which the neighbors settings are stored, used to look up the
corresponding connectivities and distances matrices in .obsp.

output.description:
Output h5mu file, with the PAGA graph abstraction results stored in the .uns slot
pointed to by --uns_output.
output.help_text: Type: `file`, multiple: `False`, required, default: `"$id.$key.output.h5mu"`, direction: `output`, example: `"output.h5mu"`.

uns_output.description:
The .uns key under which to store the PAGA results (a dict containing the
'connectivities' and 'connectivities_tree' adjacency matrices, plus the .obs column
name used for the grouping).

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

uns_velocity_graph.description:
The .uns key under which the directed single-cell RNA velocity graph is stored.
When set, RNA velocity is used to orient edges in the abstracted graph and estimate
transitions, instead of using connectivities.

model.description: The PAGA connectivity model to use.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
